what: Agents in flight, and why. A finished agent is REMOVED from this file, not marked done — the page shows what is happening now, and history lives in git.

agents.what: Put words on the blank cards
agents.why: More than a third of the funds we put in front of the chooser say nothing at all — no line about what they pay for, nothing about who they want. We already hold that text for 506 of them and have never shown it. A Norwegian founder's list is 88% blank; a German founder's is 0%, which is why this has been invisible.

agents.what: Stop printing the same fund twice
agents.why: Twenty of the seats we publish go to a fund the founder is already being shown — one founder got five of seven rows under a single title. Those seats are not near-misses; recovering them is arithmetic rather than hope.
